itemListElement.name: Hindi Transcription in India: Free Audio to Text in 2026

mainEntity.name: How can I transcribe Hindi audio to text for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Google Docs voice typing with हिन्दी selected, YouTube auto-captions for videos, or the free plan of an AI transcription tool. For meetings, Lynkk's free plan covers 5 notes a month with Hindi support.
Yes. Google Docs voice typing supports Hindi in Chrome, YouTube generates Hindi auto-captions, and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text supports Hindi as a paid API.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Hindi transcription and translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcription writes spoken Hindi as Hindi text. Translation converts Hindi into another language, such as English. Transliteration writes Hindi words in Roman script.
Some tools can. Lynkk has a Hinglish setting for meetings where speakers switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence. Many other tools expect one language per recording.

mainEntity.name: Which app is best for Hindi transcription of meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: For meetings, an AI meeting assistant that supports Hindi is the most practical choice, because it also summarises and lists action items. Lynkk supports Hindi and Hinglish on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and in person.

AI Hindi transcription is accurate for clear audio with one speaker at a time.
